name: CiteSite
tagline: Checks a paper's citations and statistics against real sources to catch fabricated or misused references.

awards: Best Use of Hermes -- Nous Research

problem: Conferences are flooded with AI-generated submissions with fake citations.
solution: Extracts citations, claims and statistics from a PDF and resolves each against scholarly databases to confirm existence and support.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a paper and see flagged citations.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Hermes -- Nous Research” and “Best use of Lava API” among 212 submissions.

lessons: Verification tools gain value as generation gets cheaper.
